nom: Versed The Purist Daily Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: A few reviewers with combination-to-oily skin say the gel lathers well and leaves their skin balanced rather than stripped, and several reviewers with other skin types specifically recommend it as a good fit for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: many describe it as a rare gel cleanser that hydrates without stripping, even calling it ideal for very dry skin, while several others with dry skin found it left their skin tight, insufficiently hydrated, or drying over time, and prefer a cream cleanser or extra moisturizer afterward.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one with an oily T-zone and dry cheeks, say it cleans evenly across both zones without over-drying or over-stripping either.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with reactive or fragrance-sensitive skin, report no irritation and a gentle, non-stripping cleanse; a minority report the opposite — one developed eczema after what she describes as a reformulation, one broke out badly, and a reviewer with rosacea saw breakouts with daily use.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying her skin as normal-to-dry says it leaves her face refreshed without dryness or 'pulling.'
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin disagree: one says it didn't provide the moisture she normally gets from a hyaluronic-acid product and would only use it as a pre-cleanse, while two others describe it as gentle and well suited to mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers highlight the antioxidant blend for visible brightness and evenness with continued use, and one reviewer specifically reports fewer fine lines alongside less redness and dullness; another credits it with fading post-breakout dark marks faster than usual and recommends it for early signs of aging.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers are split on hydration: many, including some with dry or ultra-dry skin, say it leaves skin soft and hydrated without stripping, while several others — including reviewers with dry skin — report it left their skin tight, insufficiently hydrated, or outright drying without a moisturizer layered after.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers report the cleanser calmed redness on their own skin with regular use; a reviewer with rosacea found it tolerable only at reduced frequency, since daily use caused breakouts for her.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers, including several licensed estheticians recommending it for sensitized or compromised skin barriers, consistently describe the soap-free formula as non-stripping and barrier-supportive; no reviewer reports barrier irritation from the formula itself.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report visible fading of dark spots with continued use — one from post-breakout marks, another from broader discoloration and hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who call themselves acne-prone, report calmer skin and fewer breakouts, with one crediting it directly with reduced acne; dissenting reviewers include one whose sensitive skin broke out badly after a described reformulation, and a reviewer with rosacea who saw breakouts at twice-daily use that resolved when she cut back to every other day.
concerns.oiliness: The gel formula is described as effective at lifting excess oil and sebum without over-stripping; reviewers with combination-oily skin say it leaves their skin balanced rather than shiny or stripped.

As a licensed cosmetologist I have learned tons in my 15 years of practice. But one this is that skin is ever changing and can be affected by so many factors. I have had the most clear skin when I faithfully cleanse my skin twice a day. This is not always possible with a busy life but I know it can be benefiting. This cleanser is safe for daily use. It does not have any harm scent. I love a pump cleanser for easy measuring of amount to use. I was able to use for a full two weeks but did see some minor breakouts. My skin is sensitive and I do have rosacea. So it would be better for someone I believe without rosacea. I did switch to using it every other day and saw far breakouts. So while it was not for me it is a nice product. I am 34 years old and have had acne prone skin my whole life. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

I love this company. I have been an esthetics for the last 13 years. There is a flood of clean skincare lines out right now and Versed is at the top of the list for clean and effective skin care that is suited for all genders skin types and conditions. However, I wasn't a fan of this cleanser for my mature skin. It is a simple cleanser really well suited for teens and those in their 20's and 30's. It's chock full of antioxidants aloe and B vitamins great for sensitive skin, dry skin, inflamed skin and could probably help with some types of acne. It has no add fragrance, no detergents and a clean ingredient deck that supports cell turnover. For my mature skin it didn't provide they type of moisture I normally get from a hyaluronic acid. But would happily use this as a pre cleanse. **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**

If you're looking for a gentle and effective cleanser that can remove impurities without stripping your skin, you might want to try Versed, the purest antioxidant cleaner. This is a soap-free cleansing jelly that you massage into wet skin and rinse off with cool water. It contains superfruit antioxidants from blueberry, raspberry, apple, and cucumber extracts, which are soothing, nourishing, and anti-aging for the skin. It also has glycerin and aloe, which help to hydrate, plump, and smooth the skin.I have been using this cleanser for about 3 weeks now and I love how it makes my skin feel. My skin feels clean, soft, and refreshed after every use. I also notice less redness, dullness, and fine lines on my skin. The cleanser has a light and silky texture that glides easily on the skin. It doesn't foam up too much, but it still cleanses thoroughly and it has no fragrance, which is great for sensitive skin. It's also vegan, cruelty-free, and dermatologist-tested, which are important for me.As a skincare expert and reviewer for over 5 years now, I think this cleanser is suitable for all skin types, especially those who want to protect their skin from environmental damage and signs of aging **This review was created through an educational promotional event hosted between the brand and beauty experts.**
